# Setup
 
## Load libraries 
```{r, include = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
```

## Load data
```{r, echo=F}
d <- read.csv('Data/P_Concentration.csv') %>% 
  filter(., Harvest != 'Seedling')

d <- d %>%
mutate(Harvest = as_factor(Harvest)) %>%
mutate(Harvest = fct_relevel(Harvest, "Early_Vegetative", "Late_Vegetative", "Early_Flower", "Late_Flower"))
table(d$Harvest)


head(d)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

```

# Analysis
## P Concentration
### Model fitting

```{r}
mod <- lm((P.ppm.) ~  Fertilization*Domestication*Harvest, 
           data = d)

plot(mod)
summary(aov(mod))
#Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Domestication ~ Harvest | Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Domestication|Harvest|Fertilization)

emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Domestication*Harvest, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Fertilization*Domestication), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=F)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Domestication, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Domestication'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```

### Data visualization
```{r}
p <- ggplot(aes(x=Harvest, y=response), data = df) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Domestication, group=Domestication),
            stat='summary',fun='mean',size=1) +
  geom_errorbar(width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
                    group=Domestication,color=Domestication))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('darkblue','darkorange2'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -3, hjust = -0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Fertilization, ncol=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Phosphorus Concentration (mg/kg)")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p
#ggsave(plot=p, 'output/shoot_biomass.png', width = 12, height = 6)
```

## P Uptake

### Model fitting
```{r}
mod <- lm(log(P_content) ~  Fertilization*Domestication*Harvest, 
           data = d)

plot(mod)
summary(aov(mod))
#Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Domestication ~ Harvest | Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 

emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Domestication|Harvest|Fertilization)

emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Harvest, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Fertilization*Harvest*Domestication, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Fertilization*Harvest), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=F)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Harvest, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Harvest'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```

### Data visualization
```{r}
p <- ggplot(aes(x=Harvest, y=response), data = df) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Domestication, group=Domestication),
            stat='summary',fun='mean',size=1) +
  geom_errorbar(width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, 
                    group=Domestication,color=Domestication))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('darkblue','darkorange2'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -2, hjust = -0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Fertilization, ncol=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Phosphorus Uptake (mg)")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p
ggsave(plot=p, 'output/p_uptake.png', width = 12, height = 6)
```



```{r}   
d <- read.csv('Data/Olsen-P.csv') %>% 
  filter(., !is.na(mg.kg))

d <- d[-111,]
d <- d[-9,]

```

```{r}
mod <- lm((mg.kg) ~  Harvest*Fertilization*Domestication, data=d)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod)
summary(mod)
co <- mod$coefficients

level_order <- factor(d$Harvest, levels = c('Early_Veg', 'Late_Veg','Early_Flower',"Late_Flower","Fruit"))
p <- ggplot(aes(group=Domestication,x=level_order, y=(mg.kg)), data = d) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,color='gray50')+
  geom_line(stat='summary',fun='mean',color='black',size=1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(fill=Domestication, color=Domestication))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#3498db','#f39c12'))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#3498db','#f39c12'))+
  facet_wrap(~Fertilization, ncol=2)+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Log-Transformed Root Biomass")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p

```

```{r}
#t1
mod <- lm((mg.kg) ~  Domestication*Fertilization, data=t1)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod)
aov.mod <- aov(mod)
summary(aov.mod)
t<-HSD.test(mod, "Fertilization");t
sum_shoot <-summarise(group_by(t1, Domestication,Fertilization),
  n = n(),
  mean = mean((mg.kg)),
  sd = sd((mg.kg)),
  se = sd/sqrt(n))  
sum_shoot$letters<-c('a','a','a','a')
p1<-ggplot(sum_shoot, aes(Fertilization, mean, fill = Domestication)) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -.5, hjust = -0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#3498db','#f39c12'))+
  labs(y='Olsen P (mg/kg)')+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-se, ymax = mean+se),position=position_dodge(0.9), width = .25)+
  ggtitle(label = 'Early Vegetative')+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title=element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = 'none');p1
#t2

res

  mean = mean((mg.kg)),

  se = sd/sqrt(n))  %>% 
  left_join(.,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Domestication'))
sum_shoot$.group <- gsub(' ','',sum_shoot$.group)

names(sum_shoot)[names(sum_shoot) == '.group'] <- 'letters'

p2<-ggplot(sum_shoot, aes(Fertilization, mean, fill = Domestication)) +
```
